title: Open a 30,000 PLN credit line before 30 November
summary: On 30 November salaries go out before your biggest client has paid. Without action the accounts will be about 7,900 PLN short for a week - or about 28,000 PLN short if Nordwind pays three weeks later. A 30,000 PLN revolving line covers both cases.

why: Salaries and contractor invoices of 58,000 PLN leave on 30 Nov
Nordwind's 18,400 EUR invoice is 7 days overdue; this client pays 23 days late on average
You owe employees 5,169 PLN for purchases made with their own cards - this is not visible on the bank account

calculation.label: Lowest projected balance
calculation.formula: 38,400 - 14,300 VAT + 36,900 Meblostyl - 58,000 pay run - 5,169 reimbursements - 5,701 other fixed costs

calculation.label: Proposed limit
calculation.formula: stress shortfall 28,170 rounded up to the next 5,000

calculation.label: Estimated cost
calculation.formula: 7,870 PLN x 7 days x 11.5% / 365, fee 1% of limit (illustrative price list of the simulated bank)

alternatives.label: Send Nordwind a payment reminder today
alternatives.pros: Free; may remove the gap entirely

alternatives.label: Do nothing
alternatives.cons: Unarranged overdraft or failed salary transfers

assumptions: Interest rate and fee come from the simulated bank's price list, not a real offer

proposed_action.preview: SIMULATED: sends a credit-line application for 30,000 PLN / 60 days to the sandbox bank. No real bank is contacted.

title: Pay Jan back 1,299.00 PLN for the monitor
summary: Jan paid for a monitor with his own card and sent the receipt. The receipt has no company tax number, so 242.90 PLN of VAT cannot be recovered. Paying Jan back as a reimbursement (not as extra hours) avoids income tax and social security on it.

why: The receipt was forwarded by an employee
No matching payment exists on any company account or on your private card
The receipt shows no buyer tax id

evidence.label: Why we think Jan paid privately
VAT deduction needs an invoice issued to the company

proposed_action.preview: SIMULATED: books the cost, records 1,299.00 PLN owed to Jan and adds a transfer draft to the 30 Nov payment run in the sandbox bank.
